submitted.rationale: Highest measured photocurrent (1.41e-5 A). XRD shows monoclinic BiVO4 (Q≈1.34, 2.03, 2.65) with a secondary Cu-vanadate reflection (Q≈1.93). This mixed-phase composition, Bi0.29Cu0.20V0.51, outperformed both the Bi-rich, nearly single-phase BiVO4 sample (idx 49, 1.8e-6 A) and a more Cu/V-rich step (idx 51, 6.7e-6 A), which suggests a local optimum near idx 22.

rejected.reason: Measured 1.81e-6 A, about 8x lower than idx 22 despite being nearly single-phase BiVO4
Measured 6.67e-6 A; extrapolating toward more Cu and V lowered the photocurrent
No BiVO4 is expected there (only Cu/Bi oxides), so it was not given merit budget
